title: Integrated admin authoring controls and site structure

story.need: choose visual settings, add media, and connect site content without leaving the work in progress
story.outcome: the admin workspace feels deliberate, previews choices in context, and makes broken internal links visible before publication

scope: Apply one spacious, legible control treatment to admin text fields, text areas, and selects
Browse and search the current Google Fonts catalog with live family previews
Offer only the weights published for the selected Google Font family
Edit semantic colors with a full saturation and hue picker, direct hexadecimal input, and useful swatches
Upload, preview, crop, describe, save, and select an image from every media-bearing authoring context
Show the site as pages, page layouts, navigation membership, and link-health relationships
Choose internal content targets by page while retaining safe custom external links
nonGoals: A free-form canvas that bypasses governed blocks
Deleting media that is referenced by content
Downloading or redistributing Google Font binaries
Replacing revisioned draft and publish workflows
dataRequirements: Google Font catalog entries include family, category, and published upright weights
Cropped images are uploaded as normal validated assets and content continues to store stable media identifiers
Page-aware links continue to store safe href values so public rendering and MCP contracts remain compatible
Link health is derived from current page revisions and the current settings draft rather than stored separately
permissions: Authenticated editors may browse fonts, upload media, and inspect site structure
Existing media, settings, content, and publish permissions remain authoritative
Anonymous visitors receive none of the admin catalogs or authoring controls

mcpImpact.notes: Stored contracts are unchanged; richer admin controls call the existing application services and APIs.

acceptanceCriteria.when: an editor enters or reviews text
then: text has consistent vertical and horizontal breathing room
labels, help text, focus, disabled, and error states remain legible in light and dark appearances

acceptanceCriteria.when: an editor opens the family chooser
then: the Google Fonts catalog is searchable
candidate names render in their own family
only weights available for the selected family can be chosen
at least one weight always remains selected
a saturation and hue surface is available
the current and previous colors are visible
hex input and reusable swatches stay synchronized

acceptanceCriteria.given: a media-bearing settings or block field
acceptanceCriteria.when: an editor chooses a local image
then: the image is previewed in place
crop, zoom, rotation, alt text, and decorative state are available before upload
saving uploads through the shared media service and immediately associates the returned media ID with the content
every page exposes its governed block layout and publication state
navigation membership and inbound links are visible
unresolved internal links and unlinked pages are called out
edit-layout and navigation actions lead directly to the relevant authoring context

fixtures: Google Fonts catalog with static and variable families
settings with valid and broken internal links
landscape image cropped square and wide
published, draft-only, linked, and unlinked pages
verification: Font catalog parsing and weight-selection unit tests
Inline media upload and crop browser test
Theme control and Site structure browser review
Existing media, settings, page, MCP, accessibility, and deployment checks
